Great beer great times! They have a great mix of spaces where they have a traditional tasting room, outside beer garden, pinball room, and best of all huge arcade room! They have pay and play with old school and new cabinets. this is a welcoming place that has a space for everyone.

My favorite brewery / place to hang out in the city! Great beer, great vibes, wonderful staff! I love how much of a community space it is – Peabody really supports and elevates other Baltimore small businesses and makers. There are fun events, live music, and of course, the arcade games!

googleReviews: Joshua the manager and Joshua the bartender were amazing! We came from NYC, believing (and it’s true) that this is the only real brewery in town making beer on site. When we arrived, we discovered it was closed for a private wedding. Seeing how disappointed we were, Joshua the bartender, Joshua the manager, and the new chef kindly accommodated us so we could still enjoy their beer. They were so welcoming—and the beer was phenomenal! We heard the food is also incredible, so we’ll definitely be back to try it. Highly recommended—300%—to everyone in town!

I’ve waited 18 months and 8 visits before rating this place and posting this review. First of all, I’ve loved every beer I’ve had here - except for the one I had today, it was just okay.

The space is huge and the decor is great, this could be such a great European-style brewery complete with a Biergarten in the back. The food is also excellent, even if just a little pricey. The events? The events are great! They have fun events and educational events and community events. Again, there is a lot of space and that works well for many great events.

But sadly, the service is mediocre at best and negligent at worst. And it’s not even the servers themselves, I’ve had some great servers, but there has never been enough staff for the amount of patrons. In my opinion, the problem comes from the lack of identity of this place. Is it a restaurant with table service? Is it a brewery with counter service? It looks like a brewery but “attempts” to operate as a restaurant. Why have table service if you are going to have a single server/bar person for about 14 tables of 6 and 10 barstools? That’s a lot of people for a single server, no matter how great she is. And she was great today! She was working so hard and had a positive attitude.

I guess I’m hoping the owners read this and realize they need to staff this place better, with more people, and with better trained people. During my visits I’ve experienced the following: poorly trained servers who didn’t know how to operate the handheld Toast device; servers who disappeared for more than 15 minutes; food that didn’t show up for over 30 minutes and when I inquired the server had to go to the kitchen and ask only to find out they had ‘dropped the food and the plate broke so they had to remake it’ but failed to inform anyone about this mishap; hosts that ignored me as I was standing by the front door for a while; upstairs bar that was meant to be staffed during an event but no one showed up which left 2 servers attempting to serve more than 80 thirsty and hungry patrons.

This place has so much potential, and people still show up. And I’ll probably still come for the events they have or to meet with friends who live in the area, but I’ll just sit at the bar and hope that’s a better experience. This place could be so much better and I’m really sad that it’s not.

A solid 4 - liked it, but dinged by a few things. Pros: huge steins of traditional beer styles pair well with their flavorful German sausages; repurposed space is clean and relaxed. Cons: table service was lackluster for accuracy or speed; pricey versus comparable Baltimore brewpub spots.

My wife and I had lunch and attended a Law & Order spoof show at the Guilford Hall Brewery in Baltimore.

Street parking seemed to be the only parking available.

At first glance, the venue didn't seem to be wheelchair accessible because there was a short flight of stairs leading from the entry to the restaurant, but on your right, as you enter the front door, there's an elevator. And it's not one of those teeny afterthought elevators, it's a real, standard size elevator.

We split two appetizers, the Margherita flatbread appetizer and the supersize mozzarella cheese stick with marinara sauce. Both were delicious, and we didn't feel the need for any more food for lunch.

Service was friendly, but a bit slow. The show was one floor up, and we took the elevator.

We got married here last month, and I've got nothing but great things to say.

First, the food and drink were just stellar. We knew that we were in for a treat because of the tasting, but we had so many guests come up to us and say how delicious the food was. One of our neighbors here in Baltimore remarked on how he didn’t know about the brewery before but can’t wait to come back. My husband doesn’t drink, and rather than just having a soda/lemonade, José had a special non-alcoholic spritzer waiting just for him. Those little touches were so meaningful to us, and say a lot about how Guilford is thoughtful about the guest experience.

Despite being relatively new to the staff, Dani was incredibly helpful and very responsive in answering all of my numerous questions. When she wasn’t sure about the answer (for example, a very specific technical question about A/V equipment) she was able to point me to the right person who could assist. She also was gracious in allowing me to store a few items in the basement the night prior to the wedding so we didn’t have to carry so many things the day of. She was also very organized, including developing floor plans to make sure I liked them, checking placements, etc.

googleReviews: Really cool brewery! Their prices are very solid for the tasty beers they have on tap, the staff are friendly, atmosphere is relaxed, and the beers are great. Cant go wrong here, 10/10 would recommend!

We recently had our wedding at Monument City Brewing, and it was nothing short of perfect! The space was beautiful, the atmosphere warm and welcoming, and the team went above and beyond to make our day feel special and seamless.

A huge thank you to Ken and his wife Kim for being so incredibly supportive and accommodating throughout the planning process and on the day itself.

We also can’t say enough good things about the amazing bartenders, Jen and Tracy. They were awesome, friendly and so helpful.

If you're looking for a beautiful, and well-run venue for your event—or just want to enjoy great beer in a great space—Monument City Brewing is the place to go. We are so grateful and will cherish the memories made here forever! 🍻💛

Great ambiance, friendly and fast service. This is a dog friendly Brewery. There is plenty of off-street parking available for free. Beer tended to be average to above average. They have some high ABV beers too. Their best beer is their dessert Stout called Bulls-Eye. It's absolutely divine!

This is definitely more of a chill environment here. It's family friendly and the crowd is a nice mix of young to older.

Take a look at the amazing doors when you come in.

My partner and I recently hosted our wedding reception at Monument City Brewing Company and they were fantastic to work with! If you're looking for a beautiful, convenient space to host a private event with very reasonable and flexible terms, check them out.

Went here on a Saturday and it was packed!! Really great beer but sometimes had to wait in a 15 minute line to get it. I liked the 51 Rye with Apricot & Battle IPA with Mango. Will definitely be back though, they have some fun events on certain nights like bingo and live music, there was a food truck there for anyone who wanted food as well.
customer_insights: Monument City Brewing Company offers a relaxed and friendly atmosphere, making it an excellent choice for casual gatherings, family outings, and even private events like weddings. With a variety of beers on tap and occasional events like bingo and live music, it caters to a diverse crowd, ensuring a good time for all.

googleReviews: This area has several businesses collaborating together. There is something for everyone! You union brewery that serves awesome pizza! There wine place and spirits place which serves unique named beverages which they make themselves. The had gin flight which was great for the price! Definitely would go there again. The wine place serves food which you need to make reservations ahead of time since they're usually busy.

A great atmosphere with awesome beer and fun staff. The food is a little pricey but good. There is a huge variety of beer and ciders on tap, bottles, and cans. They also have a cute photo booth in the trailer that they have in the room. There is plenty of space and it wasn't too crowded. Would love to go back next time I'm around the Baltimore area.

The Wine Collective located in the Union Collective in Baltimore City...a refreshing getaway on a Tuesday evening, listening to fresh, original, enticing jazz, (Jack Gussio jazz group is a must hear) while sipping some extraordinary wines  (peregrine, wizard, and pinot gris) is the way to spend your evening...and if you're lucky, your favorite love will ask you to walk around the corner to see the holiday lights on 34th Street in Baltimore City.

This is THE spot to go for a great night of varied drinks and snacks! Went with friends on black Friday and hit up Union Brewing, The Cocktail Gallery, and The Wine Collective! All of the drinks were amazing, and the food at The Wine Collective was exactly what exactly needed after a night of drinks.

This is a great place to have a few craft beers. The eatery doesn't have huge variety, but it is good food if small portions for the price. Inflation I guess. If you are coming here to talk it is a bit loud. There is outside seating, but not the most pleasant on a hot day. The novelties vending machine was fun.
customer_insights: Union Collective in Baltimore offers a vibrant atmosphere with a variety of craft beers, wines, and unique cocktails. It's a great spot for social gatherings, with options for food and live music, making it suitable for pregaming and casual nights out.

googleReviews: I love this spot so much!!! The vibe is welcoming and fun with all the pinball machines and the tailgates they host for the Ravens games. Even if you’re not a football fan, there’s something for everyone! I appreciate how community-oriented they are with events and local collabs. And of course, the beer is amazing and creative.

Wico is an absolute gem—excellent beers, amazing food, and a vibe that hits just right. It’s dog friendly, the staff makes you feel instantly at home, and the pinball machines plus occasional live music add to the experience. This place truly stands out. Highly recommend stopping in and experiencing this brewery for yourself!

Really good brewery tucked away in pigtown! Their selection has all types of beers(hazy,amber,maibock,sours,lagers) and even craft seltzer on tap with added flavors for the NA folx!
A nice selection of newer, well maintained pinball machines and a bunch of boardgames and sometimes a N64. Would recommend if you're looking for a chill vibe in the area. Bring your own food, or dog!
The best guys, great beer, great food! Perfect game day spot!! 12 minute skip to ravens walk! Awesome for events too, lively space, fun events! Def worth checking out

Loved our experience. The bartenders are super nice, and the beer is delightful. I especially enjoyed the sour. The seating was comfortable. We would return just for their pup alone - she was a very good girl. They have a wide array of pinball machines and board games. And I was impressed at how many events they do, from corn hole to paint and sip events. We'll definitely be back.
customer_insights: Wico Street Beer Co is a vibrant brewery in Baltimore known for its welcoming atmosphere, excellent beer selection, and community-focused events. With fun activities like pinball machines and live music, it’s a great spot for both casual hangouts and game day celebrations.

googleReviews: Had a great experience at Mobtown last month for the Breaking Bradish premier. The IPA itself was very good. Good balance of flavor and it went down smoothly. Interior design with the murals is really cool. Plus the opportunity they provided that night to let us meet some of the Baltimore Orioles, including Kyle Bradish himself, was amazing. Loved taking home a signed Breaking Bradish can! That means a lot to me, a die-hard Orioles fan. Glad I was able to take a four-pack of the Breaking Bradish home, and I'd love to come back sometime next season to try some more beer before an Orioles game!

I hosted my sister’s bridal shower here and it was absolutely fantastic. Everyone I dealt with was friendly. They were very easy going and accommodating and most importantly the beer and drinks were delicious. I strongly recommend visiting this spot and considering it for your next event!

One of the best breweries in Baltimore! They have a great selection of different brews and every one is worth a try. I'm always excited when they announce a new beer because they never miss the mark. They host great events and have great food truck during the weekends. Service is always friendly and helpful. If your looking for good beer look no further!

Roomy industrial-style brewery with plenty of seating, plus fun colorful artwork and murals on the walls. Nice draft list, I like their IPAs the best. Friendly staff. The couple times I’ve been here I’ve found street parking fairly easily just a couple blocks away. They are also dog friendly, there were lots of well-behaved pups hanging around!

Good beer. One Two Punch is a strong triple IPA. A bit on the sweeter side but not cloyingly so. Their Baltic Porter is on point with just a hint of chocolate. Was not a fan of their white barrel aged stout. A little after taste on the back end did not mesh with my pallet. But the imperial was not bad. I am looking forward to trying their hazy IPA's, and their Belgium Quad. Very eclectic place I would highly recommended it. Parking will be a challenge though.
customer_insights: Mobtown Brewing Company is a lively brewery in Baltimore known for its great selection of craft beers and friendly atmosphere. It hosts various events, making it a popular spot for gatherings and celebrations, while also being dog-friendly.

googleReviews:
Chill little brewery out on one of the old industrial peninsulas in Dundalk. We like their beer and their little popcorn machine which was a great idea for a brewery. They have shuffleboard darts and board games.
I like their imperial stout which packed a punch, but also the all days off. Lager had solid flavor. Nothing crazy about it.
I also have an eagle cam which is a camera overlooking an eagle's nest that isn't above the parking lot. Pretty cool to watch the birds.
Excellent beer and a really nice pleasant atmosphere.  Chelsea our bartender was fantastic!  We will definitely return!

We hosted private event at the brewery.  The atmosphere was friendly.   Dillion, Joe  and staff were cordial and very flexible with arrangements.  Thank you.  I'll be back!    Oh yes.......the beer was good too!

Delicious addition to the area. Nice open venue with free pool, free pinball, and a couple TVs. There was a food truck outside when we visited, but not the previous time. The bar offers flights of any quantity, 10oz and 16oz pours, and growler fills.

Good beers on draft-classic lager, stout (non-coconut), and rose' seltzer. I love their Undertow gose'! ONLY tasting room with LIVE osprey cam which displays local nest in their parking lot!! We'll be back!🪹🪶🍻
customer_insights: Key Brewing Co. offers a relaxed atmosphere with a variety of games and a unique eagle cam, making it a fun spot for casual gatherings. The brewery is well-received for its solid beer selection and friendly staff, making it a great place for groups looking to unwind.

address: 1399 S Sharp St, Baltimore, MD 21230, USA
googleReviews: Minor negatives: staff really had no idea what they were doing 😅, and it's a giant location basically under a bridge. Positives: sleek, high-investment brewery, with a range of food and beer options near the stadium. Appreciated the Australian/New Zealand hop focus. Excellent merch.

M8 Beer is definitely worth a stop if you’re looking to try some interesting brews in a laid-back setting. The atmosphere was spacious, clean, and had a good energy without being too loud—perfect for a casual drink or hangout. There were 4 TVs near the bar playing sports, which added to the relaxed, social vibe.

The staff was super friendly and welcoming, offering samples and answering questions without pressure. I appreciated being able to try 5 oz pours, which made it easy to sample a few beers without committing to a full pint.

I came to check out the beer specifically and really enjoyed the Morning Mugs collab—a smooth coffee milk stout that was flavorful without being too heavy. I also tried the Outback, which was another solid choice. Attached a beer menu photos for other options.

Although I didn’t get to try the food, the menu looked great and reasonably priced (attached for reference). I’ll definitely be back—whether it’s for more beer or to check out the food next time. Great spot overall!

Family friendly place with great food and great beer as well as a stellar cocktail menu paying homage to Australia and using some spirits from down under. Upstairs bar was set up for a ticketed trivia event. Menu had tasty fried pickles and a tasty falafel burger for this vegetarian. 🙂

First brewery of our trip and it didn’t disappoint! Staff was super friendly and my cousin had a great time exploring more of Baltimore. Figured it was an Australian inspired brewery too
Good hidden message lol 😎🍻

M8 Brewery – A Hidden Gem in Baltimore
We stopped by M8 Brewery on a whim while exploring the Ravens Stadium neighborhood, and what a great find it turned out to be! The atmosphere was warm and relaxed — the perfect spot to grab a craft beer and soak in some local vibes.
We sat at the bar, enjoyed a couple of great brews, and chatted with the friendly staff. A gentleman sat nearby and struck up an easy conversation with us — humble, down-to-earth, and clearly passionate about the place. It wasn’t until after he left that the bartender mentioned he was actually the owner! That kind of humility says a lot about the character of this place.
The beer was excellent, the service was genuine, and the overall experience was memorable. Whether you’re a local or just passing through, M8 Brewery is absolutely worth a stop — great people, great beer, and great energy.
customer_insights: M8 Beer is a spacious and relaxed brewery perfect for casual hangouts, offering a variety of craft beers and a friendly atmosphere. With a focus on Australian and New Zealand hops, patrons appreciate the unique brews and welcoming staff, making it a great spot for both locals and visitors.

address: 8251 Telegraph Rd Suite D, Odenton, MD 21113, USA
googleReviews:
Don't let this location fool you!!! There's not a ton going on outside but it's inside where you wanna be anyways!  The sours and beers are fantastic.  They have mead, I'm not a mead guy, so idk but choices are awesome.

There's a brick oven!!!!

You owe yourself to come here. It's so great.

They have an excellent selection of beer with consistent, cute art. It seems they rotate about 2 taps every few weeks, so there is a lot of variety. They also sell mead from a nearby meadery. They have a kitchen in-house that makes excellent thin crust pizza, along with things like pretzels, wings, and deserts. The trivia every Wednesday is a good level of difficulty and lasts about 2 hours.
Great beer selection with feisty pop culture names and eye grabbing art. Food is also decent! We'll be back!

I love a good pizza place, especially one that uses a brick oven. I had heard of their beer, but didn't know they had a pizza joint until my office went there for a business lunch. You order at the table using a QR code, which makes the process quick. Plenty of seating for smaller groups, but a little harder for bigger groups depending on the date and time. It took a bit to get a drink because there were quite a few people in line to order, but everyone working there was very friendly and accommodating. The food was fantastic and I've been looking forward to my next trip. You will not be disappointed in the food. I recommend this place!

It's such an awesome place. You walked in, and you could smell the food, which smelled fantastic. Huge variety of beers. They brew all the beers there. You can actually see where they brew them. I highly recommend this brewery.
customer_insights: Crooked Crab Brewing Company is a vibrant brewery in Baltimore known for its fantastic selection of craft beers and delicious brick oven pizzas. The atmosphere is lively and casual, making it a great spot for groups or a fun night out, with trivia nights adding to the entertainment.

address: 1625 Union Ave Suite C, Baltimore, MD 21211, USA
googleReviews: Waverly Brewing is unlike most breweries you might visit. It's got small neighborhood bar charm, great owners and staff who loving working with their community & city. Lots of fun events and you can't beat the vibes!  Almost forgot... the beers great too!

Waverly makes great craft beer and their tasting room is a great hang out spot. They have more than a dozen beers on tap. They also have wine, which is wonderful, as my wife doesn't drink beer.
Staff is friendly and attentive. Definitely will head back there next time I'm in the area.

Rerouted from Union to try out waverly per a friends request and it did not disappoint! Hole in the wall speakeasy meets dive bar meets brewery! Low key vibes, rustic basement feel! This isnt for beer snobs but instead for those who want to sip and chill. LOVE LOVE LOVE Mel! Will definitely be back!

This place is awesome! Excellent beer. Excellent atmosphere. Chatted with Mel- and she’s honestly one of the best humans. If you are looking for a family friendly and inclusive (ie. very queer friendly) place to enjoy local brews- look no further.

Loved the beer here! They have a great variety of options, and some ciders as well. I loved the Pilsner and the Blonde Ale. They don’t have their own food but have rotating food from other restaurants available (it was sandwiches and salad this weekend). There is plenty of space and a brewing room that has tables as well. They have cornhole and seating outside for when it’s warm. Will definitely be back!
customer_insights: Waverly Brewing Company is a beloved local brewery known for its friendly atmosphere and community involvement. With a diverse selection of craft beers and a welcoming vibe, it's perfect for casual hangouts, friendly gatherings, and even first dates.

address: 4615 Hollins Ferry Rd # A, Halethorpe, MD 21227, USA
googleReviews: Been visiting from Germany, doing a brewery tour (among other things) in Baltimore. It’s not easy to get there if you don’t have a car and are in Baltimore city-proper, but def worth it! Great beers, super-friendly and helpful folks there and the place as such is awesome. You can play games like cornhole while enjoying your beers. Also cool merch and there’s a nice bbq-foodtruck there! By any chance - don’t miss it!!
Super friendly staff, delicious brews, great decor, and chill music playlists 😌 Nearly everyone in the brewery had ordered flights because there’s so many tasty options to choose from 😋

Great local brewery with a long history.  The tap room is pretty nice, and they have a good bit of outdoor seating.  Loose Cannon IPA is a staple and always a good choice.  My other favorites are Double Cannon and Hazy Cannon.  They have a wide selection of beer, including seasonal beers, so I'm sure you'll find one you like.

Quick stop with our dogs for a beer and lunch. Food from the Pit Stop was great - pork BBQ sandwich and brat sandwich - plus a couple of Bodacious Blondes.

It was busy when we arrived at noon on Saturday and packed when we left at 1:30.  We opted to sit on the deck but one of the owners came out and told us dogs were welcome inside. We thanked him and said we were taking advantage of the nice weather to sit outside.

Bartenders were spot on, food was great as was the beer.

My family and I took the tour and it was very informative. The gentleman who gave it, sorry I forgot his name, was awesome. Even though it was very hot, he made it fun. We then proceeded to relax in the bar area for a few hours. Of course, my family enjoyed the beer selection. Many of which you can only get there. I'm a recovering alcoholic, so I had root beer which was quite tasty. The food truck was also, good. We are definitely going back soon.
customer_insights: Heavy Seas Beer is a lively brewery known for its friendly atmosphere and a wide selection of craft beers. Visitors enjoy the outdoor seating and food truck offerings, making it a great spot for casual gatherings with friends or family.
